text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(—Listen, everyone. Look, everyone. 
And just let yourselves get hyped up!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, every single one of them is 
waiting for fun. 
Because they came here to be an 
"audience."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(—The "fun" that Maya and the others bring 
is this!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(It's weird, it's wacky, and there isn't a 
single moment 
where you'd think it's cool, but that's—)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(—the cheer that Maya and the others 
deliver!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(It's our heart—dedicated to everyone, 
poured out with everything we've got!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heaaay! The magic power has gathered~! 
Fukukitaru, it is time for you to enter 
your perfect form, too~~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That cat is huge?! Ahaha, she 
transformed!! 
Awesome, what're they gonna do next?! It's 
not over yet, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, okie-dokie! 
Then here's one more song for the encore!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. Smile more. 
Laugh out loud, throw everything else 
away. Enjoy this moment with all your 
might!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(—We'll tickle everyone's spirits. 
So that you can smile again tomorrow!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Go for it, Witch Girl! 
Wait, whoa?! A pigeon just came out of the 
drum?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text: What is that even?! Ahahahaha—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—...Great work out there, everyone~~! 
Man~, that was a massive, massive, massive 
success! Mayano-san, Pearl-san!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm so glad everyone was having fun! 
And Fukukitaru-san's Gochujang Kitty 
really got the crowd pumped!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The audience had smiles on their 
faces the whole time... 
We were able to accomplish everything we 
set out to do.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru, Mayano. Thank you for going 
along with this.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, not at all! When everyone is 
happy, 
it makes me super happy too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya should be the one thanking you! It 
turned into a live concert 
we couldn't have even imagined at the 
start, but we really—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: —Maya-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Great job! I saw the concert! Now I 
totally get why you told me to come! 
It was super fun to watch, completely 
goofy, but, but still—!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —It was crazy cool, wasn't it!
